title: HOXA5-mediated spatial remodeling of tumor-immune interfaces across cancers promotes AML pathogenesis.
authors: Zhang, Changling; Wen, Ping; Zeng, Yan; Chen, Tao; Guo, Qulian; Liu, Chunyan; Zhong, Fangfang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HOXA5在泛癌中的表达与免疫调控作用，虽涉及AML机制和分子对接，但核心是表达与功能验证，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法上仅简单分子对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: HOXA5 (homeobox A5) exhibits context-dependent roles in cancer, but its pan-cancer spatial immune regulatory functions and therapeutic potential remain poorly understood. METHODS: We integrated multi-omics data from 33 cancer types (TCGA, n=11,096; GTEx, n=7,469; TISCH2; spatial transcriptomics) to characterize HOXA5 expression, genomic alterations, and immune interactions. Functional validation was performed in AML cell lines (U937, KG-1; n=3 biological replicates per experiment). RESULTS: HOXA5 was significantly dysregulated across cancers, with elevated expression in AML and GBM, and reduced expression in BRCA and LUAD. In AML, high HOXA5 expression predicted poor overall survival (HR = 2.80, 95% CI: 1.60-4.89, p < 0.001) and was associated with FLT3/NPM1 mutations. Spatial transcriptomics revealed HOXA5+ malignant cells enhance fibroblast/endothelial crosstalk via IGFBP3-TMEM219. HOXA5 knockdown suppressed proliferation (p < 0.01) and induced G0/G1 arrest. Mechanistically, HOXA5 maintained AML through cholesterol biosynthesis and ECM remodeling. Mercaptopurine was identified as a potential therapeutic agent, and molecular docking predicted a potential stable interaction with HOXA5. CONCLUSIONS: HOXA5 plays a dual role in solid versus hematologic malignancies and serves as a key spatial immune regulator. It is a robust prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target in AML, with mercaptopurine representing a promising repurposing candidate.
abstract_zh: 背景：HOXA5（同源盒A5）在癌症中表现出背景依赖性作用，但其泛癌空间免疫调控功能及治疗潜力仍知之甚少。方法：我们整合了来自33种癌症类型的多组学数据（TCGA，n=11,096；GTEx，n=7,469；TISCH2；空间转录组学），以表征HOXA5表达、基因组改变及免疫相互作用。在AML细胞系（U937、KG-1；每次实验n=3个生物学重复）中进行了功能验证。结果：HOXA5在多种癌症中显著失调，在AML和GBM中表达升高，在BRCA和LUAD中表达降低。在AML中，高HOXA5表达预测较差的总生存期（HR = 2.80，95% CI：1.60-4.89，p < 0.001），并与FLT3/NPM1突变相关。空间转录组学揭示HOXA5+恶性细胞通过IGFBP3-TMEM219增强成纤维细胞/内皮细胞串扰。HOXA5敲低抑制增殖（p < 0.01）并诱导G0/G1期阻滞。机制上，HOXA5通过胆固醇生物合成和细胞外基质重塑维持AML。巯嘌呤被确定为潜在治疗药物，分子对接预测其与HOXA5可能存在稳定相互作用。结论：HOXA5在实体瘤与血液恶性肿瘤中发挥双重作用，并作为关键空间免疫调节因子。它是AML中稳健的预后生物标志物和治疗靶点，巯嘌呤代表一个有前景的药物再利用候选药物。
